title: SAGASCALE: A REALISTIC, SCALABLE, AND HIGH-QUALITY LONG-CONTEXT BENCHMARK BUILT FROM FULL-LENGTH NOVELS
reasoning: The paper introduces and evaluates SagaScale, a benchmark specifically designed to test the long-context capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) using full-length novels. Its primary focus is on technical performance metrics, retrieval-augmented generation strategies, and data collection methodology; it does not contain an evaluation or benchmarking component related to religion, morals, or ethics.
